integration.beforeTask: actively fetch a cognibrain coding context pack for the crew task before non-trivial work
integration.contextParsing: parse context, sections[].evidence[], excludedStaleRules, id and evidencePackId; sections[].evidence[] is still delivered memory when context is empty
integration.reviewRequired: treat review_required or unsafeToInject evidence as an automated review queue; verify against current code, tests, generated artifacts, CI or source systems before using it
integration.beforeTool: check the planned tool action with /code/action-guard
integration.afterPatch: write a patch evidence trail through /patch-evidence
integration.feedback: record accepted, rejected, partially useful, or harmful context packs
